answer: Four measured cross-vendor dispatch failures each have an adapter guard and a terminal marker. Fire-and-forget (--background / background=True / wait=False) -> FAILED:<id> fire-and-forget. Inline assembled UTF-16 above 24000 (estate payload_len=34472 exceeds cap 32767) -> FAILED:<id> win-arg-limit; the same payload via --prompt-file is SUCCESS. PROGRESS-only body -> FAILED:<id> severed-stream progress-only. Schema-invalid with MCP active -> FAILED:<id> schema-invalid mcp-active (MCP does not skip the check). Every dispatch() / _checked() return (7 sites) calls terminal(). A6 DESIGN.json is absent. Reviewer added FM-JOB-RECEIPT-TEXT rather than certifying the unread 47-class list. SUCCESS:ARC-0040

question: Enumerate the cross-vendor dispatch failures already measured on this estate - fire-and-forget background dispatch that loses the result, Windows 32,767-character command-line overflow, a progress stream mistaken for a result, and typed output-schema failures while MCP tools are active - and specify the adapter-level guard for each plus its terminal-state marker, so every dispatch ends in SUCCESS:<id> or FAILED:<id> <reason> and never in silence.

added_failure_mode.description: A blocking foreground dispatch (no --background, wait=True) can still return only a job id or the phrase 'started in the background' because the vendor CLI defaulted to detached internally. The author's flag guard is silent. A progress-JSON guard is silent on plaintext. A typed schema check may lump this into schema-invalid, which the retry policy says must not be retried — but the true class is fire-and-forget result_role, and IMP-0425 requires a use-vs-mention gate over receipt phrasing rather than a schema miss.
added_failure_mode.required_followup: Classify plaintext job-receipt bodies as FAILED:<id> fire-and-forget before schema-invalid, with a use-vs-mention control so a result that discusses background work as subject matter still passes.
added_failure_mode.title: Plaintext job-id / 'started in the background' with exit 0

reviewer.enumeration_certify_reason: The 47 seeded classes are cited as _USER-PROMPTS.md:11300-11347. That file is not on this worktree. Certifying completeness against an unread list would be overclaim. Instead the reviewer adds FM-JOB-RECEIPT-TEXT, which the author's four named guards miss.
reviewer.method: Reviewed the four named reproductions (background flag, assembled UTF-16 argv, progress-only body, schema with MCP active) and the AST return-point enumeration. Scope is: both-states per guard, terminal markers on every dispatch return, one missed mode. Agreement that the probe-local adapter is production-wired is not required for PASS; A6 DESIGN.json is absent.

scenario.catching_architecture: A6 adapter.dispatch: refuse --background, refuse inline argv over the conservative UTF-16 threshold, classify progress-only as severed-stream, enforce output_schema even when MCP tools are active, and emit SUCCESS:<id> or FAILED:<id> <reason> from every dispatch return point.
procedure: 1. Reproduce fire-and-forget: set background=True and --background; assert FAILED fire-and-forget. Run wait=True without the flag; assert SUCCESS. Run a body that only discusses background work; assert SUCCESS (use-vs-mention).

2. Reproduce win-arg-limit: assemble an inline prompt of 34,472 characters (estate payload_len) and assert assembled UTF-16 exceeds 32,767 and the guard fires. The same payload via --prompt-file stays under the cap and SUCCESS. This Linux box does not re-hit CreateProcess 206.
3. Reproduce progress-as-result: feed a PROGRESS object and a PROGRESS NDJSON stream; assert FAILED severed-stream. A typed receipt body is SUCCESS.
4. Reproduce schema-invalid with MCP active: invalid body + mcp_tools_active=True must FAIL schema-invalid; the same valid body with MCP on is SUCCESS. MCP must not skip the schema check.
5. AST-walk dispatch and _checked; every Return must call terminal(). Inject return None into _checked and assert the enumerator fails.
scenario.silent_loss_file: a vendor job-receipt or PROGRESS-only body accepted as the unit result, so the fan-in barrier closes on silence
scenario.title: Reproduce each named dispatch failure and assert the guard

strongest_surviving_counterargument: These guards live in command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0040/adapter.py. A6 DESIGN.json is absent (ARC-0038 not delivered), so they are not the production cross-vendor adapter. The Windows CreateProcess 206 death at payload_len=34472 is catalog-measured; this Linux worktree reproduces the assembled UTF-16 length condition and refuses the inline transport, but it does not re-hit OS error 206. A dispatcher that never calls dispatch() still fails open. Strongest surviving FOR: the four reproductions plus the AST return-point list still fail-close the silent-return class on any path that does call this adapter, which is what ARC-0040 asked to specify.
